samples.question: This picture shows a row of domino-like tiles on a plain background. Each tile is split into two halves and every half is printed with one compact cluster of small dark grey dots. Exactly one small red arrow is drawn well below the row, clear of the tiles, pointing up at the butt seam where two neighbouring tiles meet. Look only at the two dot clusters nearest that arrow, one on its left and one on its right; every other cluster in the row and every mark of any other colour is decoration and must be ignored. Do those two clusters contain the same number of dark dots? Answer yes or no.
